description: Gladly customer service platform with REST API, Lookup API, webhooks and Chat SDK.
auth_notes: Token-based Basic Authentication; API tokens tied to a Gladly user with the API User permission, sent in the Authorization header over HTTPS.
gate_detail: A technical admin with a Gladly account must create the token in Settings, and the user needs the API User permission/role granted. No free signup or plan details are stated; it is a customer-account product.
api_scope: REST API for agents, customers, conversations, topics, tasks, inboxes, teams, reports, exports and webhooks, plus a Lookup API for serving your own data.
mcp_notes: Sources describe Gladly AI connecting to external MCP servers, not a Gladly-published server.
blocker_detail: Needs a Gladly customer account and an admin granting the API User permission to create tokens.

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.
These can be created within the Gladly UI, for users who have the `API User` role.
Click **Create Token**. A new token is immediately generated within the page.
Your user must have the API user permission to create and use an API token.
Clients can access the REST API via HTTPS at your organization's Gladly domain

uncertainties: Plan or pricing requirements for API access are not stated.
Sandbox is mentioned only for Chat SDK; API sandbox not confirmed.
MCP pages describe Gladly as an MCP client, not a server.
